notes.title: Workshop Beta
notes.content:
[h3]VRNOID  Workshop Beta![/h3]

Use the In-game level editor to try out your ideas. Share your levels with other players via Steam Workshop. Play levels created by other players. It's Full VR, no need to leave the game.

Workshop page is now publicly open. Improved UI and fixed critical bugs.

notes.title: New levels and "Campaign+" mode
notes.content:
[h2]New Levels[/h2]
Added 7 Extra levels to the Campaign mode. These levels have a higher difficulty and also use bricks (like axes) that have not been used in the campaign before. Each level has 5-6 stages
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39260299/977b2edc8f55a0feebcb8be4db29cec07ca7e94f.gif[/img]

[h2]Campaign +[/h2]
After you have completed the "Campaign", the "Campaign +" mode opens, in which a real challenge awaits you. This mode has difficulty modifiers that can only be partially changed. This is exactly the difficulty I wanted to achieve at the beginning of development
In addition added achievement for completing Campaign+
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39260299/28baadffc23e462e1ce75d3c2d05e067613e9a14.gif[/img]

 


[h2]Improvements[/h2]
"Tournament" mode was renamed to "Arcade" mode.  Now this mode will be available from the beginning
In "Arcade" mode, long and challenging levels await you as you would expect in classic arcade games

UI- added "Next Level" button after completing a level. 

fixed a bug- when the level is completed,  losing a ball still can cost a health


Special thanks for the support to

Devon Padgett
Brenton Stockwell
shoichiro kato
dave
Tony D
Andrew Novak

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39260299/da5f1ad51b63d2b68b10562dc3724c60b01a95ba.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 10.0, VRNOID for Meta Quest on AppLab and Sidequest
notes.content:
[i]Hello everyone, you may wonder why I was not active and there was no information about the game development for a long time.

The thing is that due to damage to power plants in Ukraine, electricity is periodically turned off. I have 8 hours and sometimes only 4 hours of electricity per day, which slows down the development process a lot. So it's hard to stay active online. However, I continue to work and want to share the progress with you[/i]


[h3]VRNOID Update 10.0[/h3]

     Reworked and improved ball physics, now the ball is more controlled and predictable. Fixed a bug when the ball flies in the wrong direction.
Improved table calibration guidance

[h3]     VRNOID was ported for Meta Quest native! [/h3]

VRNOID Full Version https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/6019968638090449/

Wireless VRNOID demo is available on:
Meta store AppLab  https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/5215972968531223/
Sidequest https://sidequestvr.com/app/11963




     Also, I reached a lot of progress with the version for Pico 4 native, and hope to soon reach a Pico store
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39260299/34dfae5c57312ba5ada517fcf5d6a79263388118.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39260299/65e7a7bbb75b5b9382944ad9a555a8963e35a00f.png[/img][/url]

   VRNOID is scheduled for release in spring 2023!


     Support the development of VRNOID on Patreon and get a digital key from each store where the game will be launched
more info https://www.patreon.com/fullmetaldeveloper
 
 
Special thanks to the patrons who have supported me all this time
-Brenton Stockwell
-Dave
-Shoichiro Kato

notes.title: VRNOID update
notes.content:
Hello everybody. I'm still here, still creating indie games and even the war can't stop me :)

Last month I worked on VRNOID and achieved a lot of progress.

Created an achievement system with 40 achievements

Personal Level: formed by collecting the best records for each campaign and tournament. Get the highest rank and collect achievements to reach the highest personal level. The higher your level, the more bricks will be unlocked in the level editor. Unlocked achievements also increase your personal level

Added a ranking system that depends on how well you beat the level and how many positive and negative modifiers you use
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39260299/50fce72361013997ed3622a3b13798f0d25637d6.png[/img]
Added a global leaderboard where you can compare personal level, each level of the campaign and tournament, as well as statistics like ball hits, or bricks destroyed

In the co-op mode (brick-breaker) added bumpers on the difficulty Beginner and Amateur
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39260299/f1fffe073fca67b23bbafde561a2c68c7d55c898.png[/img]
fixed bug with multiball bonus, previously ball sometimes goes through blocks

Added encryption of save files

Added separate saves for different Steam accounts on one PC

improved some UI elements and other fixes

I will continue to work on updates, and I plan to port VRNOID on Oculus Quest native. The release of the game will be delayed until the situation in Ukraine becomes more stable.


I would not be able to release this update without the support of my patrons:
-Brenton Stockwell
-Hunterthewolf
-Rouge
-Shoichiro Kato

Thank you guys!ːKingThumbsUpː

notes.title: VR Noid BETA
notes.content:
Hello VR Noiders
 
After the previous game festival, I decided to shift the release date to spend more time on development and bring VR Noid to a higher level

For the past year, I've improved every aspect of the game starting from game physics to UI and music

 [previewyoutube=oBRnCwen9Xk;full][/previewyoutube]
List of changes:

[list]
[*] New levels and bricks
[*] New Bosses and enemies
[*] Level Editor
[*] Coop campaign
[*] Left-hand mode
[*] Hand pivot/position calibration
[*] 8 Game modifiers
[*] Player statistics
[*] Local leaderboard
[*] Stricker charge visualization
[*] Reworked Game Physics 
[*] Reworked Sound VFX
[*] Improved Music
[*] Reworked UI
[*] Improved Room adjust
[*] SteamVR input bindings
[*] Smooth camera
[*] LIV support
[/list]
and much more

Try the demo with new content and let me know your thoughts!
